package.name: algae_dt
package.description: Custom digital-twin package for a TurtleBot3 Burger algae-bloom cleaner (TU/e 2IRR10). Thin digital-twin layer (mediator, sync supervisor, mission runner, operator GUI) on top of the stock turtlebot3 packages (turtlebot3_gazebo, turtlebot3_navigation2, turtlebot3_bringup, turtlebot3_teleop). Those packages are provided by the environment and launched at runtime, so they are intentionally not declared as build/exec deps here.
